notes.title: STACK STONES - Full Release - Play Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43155964/82d79b842fe5706f635a065828a5ea3261cf9587.gif[/img]

Finally I've reached the point to be able to release [b]STACK STONES[/b]!
This is my first commercial release as an Indie Game Developer and I'm super excited to share the game with everyone.

[i]STACK STONES, a physics based multiplayer stacking and party game with multiple game modes. Enjoy playing alone to beat your former best mark or compete against others in funny multiplayer matches ... but watch out for your opponents, they want to smash your stack![/i]

I deeply hope you enjoy playing it and also have lots of fun in the multiplayer sessions. If you encounter any issues or have improvement ideas for the gaming experience please contact me via my [url=https://discord.gg/k36etWAcRa]DISCORD[/url] or leave a message in the Steam Discussion area (Community Hub).

I will definetly check all your feedback and improve the game where ever possible. 

Thank you to all who have joined my journey and for sure to all of the new players!


Regards
Thomas
